label: Backward lifting of actual esse supply to eligible exercises
term: backward lifting of actual esse supply
definition: On one q.3 a.4 profile p, fix the eligible exercise type E, a bearer map E → B, and an interpreted causal relation C on E. For every actual esse-supplier edge c → x and every eligible exercise f borne by x, an eligible exercise e borne by c satisfies C e f. The same map and relation are used for every edge and target exercise.
note: Analyst stipulation, attribution deferred. The exercise profile supplies token individuation, eligibility and a causal interpretation of C. The bridge applies to the selected tenseless, mode-unspecified actual esse-supplier relation and remains OPEN for that interpretation. In the A₀→B₁→A₂ control, both projected edges are witnessed, but the B-to-A edge cannot lift at A₀. The alternating chain with n+1 supplying n lifts at every eligible recipient token. Neither example assumes a clock or equates the whole cause-of-esse relation with temporal origination or a specific causal mode. Exact projection by some exercise pair alone does not impose the bridge.
